description: Environment diagnostic skill for SenseNova-Skills project. Checks that sn-image-base is properly installed and configured, validates dependencies and environment variables. Prompts user to configure missing required variables and saves them to .env file. After configuration, reloads environment and suggests agent restart if needed.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
